Seqtk
-----

Seqtk is a fast and lightweight tool for processing sequences in the FASTA or
FASTQ format.

Usage Examples
--------------

* Convert FASTQ to FASTA:

        seqtk seq -a in.fq.gz > out.fa

* Convert ILLUMINA 1.3+ FASTQ to FASTA and mask bases with quality lower than 20 to lowercases (the 1st command line) or to `N` (the 2nd):

        seqtk seq -aQ64 -q20 in.fq > out.fa
        seqtk seq -aQ64 -q20 -n N in.fq > out.fa

* Fold long FASTA/Q lines and remove FASTA/Q comments:

        seqtk seq -Cl60 in.fa > out.fa

* Convert multi-line FASTQ to 4-line FASTQ:

        seqtk seq -l0 in.fq > out.fq

* Reverse complement FASTA/Q:

        seqtk seq -r in.fq > out.fq

* Extract sequences with names in file `name.lst`, one sequence name per line:

        seqtk subseq in.fq name.lst > out.fq

* Extract sequences in regions contained in file `reg.bed`:

        seqtk subseq in.fa reg.bed > out.fa

* Mask regions in `reg.bed` to lowercases:

        seqtk seq -M reg.bed in.fa > out.fa

* Subsample 10000 read pairs from two large paired FASTQ files (remember to use the same random seed to keep pairing):

        seqtk sample -s100 read1.fq 10000 > sub1.fq
        seqtk sample -s100 read2.fq 10000 > sub2.fq

* Trim low-quality bases from both ends using the Phred algorithm:

        seqtk trimfq in.fq > out.fq

* Trim 5bp from the left end of each read and 10bp from the right end:

        seqtk trimfq -b 5 -e 10 in.fa > out.fa

* Find telomere (TTAGGG)n repeats:

        seqtk telo seq.fa > telo.bed 2> telo.count

alphabet="ACGTNRYMKSWBDHVU"

p=subprocess.run(["./executable","comp","/tmp/t/compd.fa"],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
for s,l in zip(seqs,p.stdout.decode().splitlines()):
    c=l.split('\t')
    if c[9]!='0' or c[12]!='0': # name len +11 => indexes: 0 name1len 2A3C4G5T6? wait print indices
        pass
print("header indices")
for s,l in list(zip(seqs,p.stdout.decode().splitlines()))[:3]: print(s,l.split('\t'))
# print only c8 (index9) or c11(index12)
out=[]
for s,l in zip(seqs,p.stdout.decode().splitlines()):
    c=l.split('\t')
    if c[9]!='0' or c[12]!='0': out.append((s,c[9],c[12]))
print(out)

import subprocess

 ("polyA","ACGTAAAAAAAAAAAA","IIIIIIIIIIIIIIII"),

]

    for n,s,q in seqs: f.write(f"@{n}\n{s}\n+\n{q}\n")
with open('/tmp/t/probe.fa','w') as f:
    for n,s,q in seqs: f.write(f">{n}\n{s}\n")

for ffile in ["/tmp/t/probe.fq","/tmp/t/probe.fa"]:

    print("FILE",ffile)
    for flag in ["c","x","S","V","a","A"]:
        o=out(["seq",f"-{flag}",ffile])
        print(flag, "same" if o==base else "DIFF")

run(["famask","/nonexist","/tmp/t/mask.fa"])

PY"}

MASK=(1<<64)-1
NN=312; MM=156; MATRIX_A=0xB5026F5AA96619E9; UM=0xFFFFFFFF80000000; LM=0x7FFFFFFF
class MT64:
 def __init__(self,seed):
  self.mt=[0]*NN; self.mt[0]=seed&MASK
  for i in range(1,NN): self.mt[i]=(6364136223846793005*(self.mt[i-1]^(self.mt[i-1]>>62))+i)&MASK
  self.mti=NN
 def gen(self):
  mag01=[0,MATRIX_A]
  if self.mti>=NN:
   for i in range(NN-MM):
    x=(self.mt[i]&UM)|(self.mt[i+1]&LM); self.mt[i]=self.mt[i+MM]^(x>>1)^mag01[x&1]
   for i in range(NN-MM,NN-1):
    x=(self.mt[i]&UM)|(self.mt[i+1]&LM); self.mt[i]=self.mt[i+MM-NN]^(x>>1)^mag01[x&1]
   x=(self.mt[NN-1]&UM)|(self.mt[0]&LM); self.mt[NN-1]=self.mt[MM-1]^(x>>1)^mag01[x&1]
   self.mti=0
  x=self.mt[self.mti];self.mti+=1
  x^=(x>>29)&0x5555555555555555; x&=MASK
  x^=(x<<17)&0x71D67FFFEDA60000; x&=MASK
  x^=(x<<37)&0xFFF7EEE000000000; x&=MASK
  x^=x>>43
  return x&MASK
 def real2(self): return (self.gen()>>11)*(1.0/(1<<53))

import sys

from mt64def import MT64
orig='1111111101100001011100000100100100111100010100110101010100100010111100100000001111000010111101110110'
orig=orig[:100]
candidates=list(range(0,10000))+[5489,19650218,123456789,987654321,0xdeadbeef,0xffffffff,0x12345678,22222,12345,999999]
# methods mapping output -> bit char
methods={
 'topbit':lambda x: '1' if x>>63 else '0',
 'lowbit':lambda x: '1' if x&1 else '0',
 'bit1':lambda x: '1' if (x>>1)&1 else '0',
 'bit31':lambda x: '1' if (x>>31)&1 else '0',
 'bit32':lambda x: '1' if (x>>32)&1 else '0',
 'bit62':lambda x: '1' if (x>>62)&1 else '0',
}
found=[]
for seed in candidates:
    m=MT64(seed); outs=[m.gen() for _ in range(100)]
    for name,fn in methods.items():
        bits=''.join(fn(x) for x in outs)
        if bits==orig: found.append((seed,name,'same'))
        if ''.join('0' if b=='1' else '1' for b in bits)==orig: found.append((seed,name,'comp'))
    if seed in [5489,11,0]:
        print('seed',seed,{name:''.join(fn(x) for x in outs[:20]) for name,fn in methods.items()})
print('found',found)

def _telo_scan(seq_norm, rotations, mlen, penalty, dropoff, skip_first, profile, out, name, tag):
    """Scan seq_norm (bytes, uppercase). Returns (max_score, max_end).
    Scored k-mers are substrings starting at j (j>=1 if skip_first else j>=0).
    max_end is end coordinate (j+mlen) of the k-mer giving max score.
    If profile, writes P/Q lines (approximation of original).
    """
    L = len(seq_norm)
    score = 0; max_score = 0; max_end = 0
    start0 = 1 if skip_first else 0
    if mlen <= 0 or L < mlen:
        return (0, 0)
    # For profile we need position-by-position display; build a map end->score as we go
    prof_scores = {}
    broken = False
    for j in range(start0, L - mlen + 1):
        kmer = seq_norm[j:j+mlen]
        if kmer in rotations:
            score += 1
        else:
            score -= penalty
        end = j + mlen
        if score > max_score:
            max_score = score; max_end = end
        prof_scores[end] = (score, max_score)
        if end > max_end and (max_score - score) >= dropoff:
            broken = True
            break
    if profile:
        if tag == 'P':
            # positions 0.. ; score at position i is cumulative for k-mers ending <= i,
            # but first scored k-mer is displayed one position late in original.
            # We reproduce the observed offset: display score for end==i (i>=mlen+1 gives first)
            cur_s = 0; cur_m = 0
            # determine last position to print
            last_end = max(prof_scores.keys()) if prof_scores else 0
            # original prints up to the break position (end) or L-1
            upto = last_end if broken else (L - 1)
            if upto > L - 1: upto = L - 1
            for i in range(0, upto + 1):
                if i in prof_scores:
                    cur_s, cur_m = prof_scores[i]
                out.write(("P\t%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\n" % (name.decode('latin1'), i, cur_s, cur_m)).encode())
        else:
            cur_s = 0; cur_m = 0
            last_end = max(prof_scores.keys()) if prof_scores else 0
            upto = last_end if broken else L
            if upto > L: upto = L
            for q in range(1, upto + 1):
                # Q position q corresponds to having traversed q bases; k-mer ending at q-1 in rev seq
                e = q - 1
                if e in prof_scores:
                    cur_s, cur_m = prof_scores[e]
                # The original displays the score of k-mer ending at q (delayed); approximate with end==q
                if q in prof_scores:
                    cur_s, cur_m = prof_scores[q]
                out.write(("Q\t%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\n" % (name.decode('latin1'), q, cur_s, cur_m)).encode())
    return (max_score, max_end)

def cmd_telo(args):
    go = Getopt('telo', args, "d:m:p:s:P")
    dropoff = 2000; motif = 'CCCTAA'; penalty = 1; min_score = 300; do_profile = False
    for ch, val in go.opts:
        if ch == 'd': dropoff = c_atoi(val)
        elif ch == 'm': motif = val
        elif ch == 'p': penalty = c_atoi(val)
        elif ch == 's': min_score = c_atoi(val)
        elif ch == 'P': do_profile = True
    # validate motif: only ACGT/acgt allowed (original asserts)
    motif_up = motif.upper()
    for ch in motif_up:
        if ch not in 'ACGT':
            prog = os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) if sys.argv else 'executable'
            err_bytes("%s: seqtk.c:2005: stk_telo: Assertion `c >= 1 && c <= 4' failed.\n" % prog)
            sys.stderr.buffer.flush()
            os.abort()
    if len(go.args) < 1:
        if go.opts:
            # original segfaults here; emulate a segfault
            sys.stdout.buffer.flush(); sys.stderr.buffer.flush()
            os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGSEGV)
            return 139
        fname = None
    else:
        fname = go.args[0]
    data = read_input_data(fname, 'telo')
    out = sys.stdout.buffer
    mlen = len(motif_up)
    rotations = set()
    if mlen > 0:
        for i in range(mlen):
            rotations.add((motif_up[i:] + motif_up[:i]).encode())
    total_bases = 0; telo_bases = 0
    for rec in iter_records(data):
        seq = rec.seq; L = len(seq)
        total_bases += L
        if mlen == 0 or L == 0:
            continue
        seq_up = bytes(to_upper_byte(c) for c in seq)
        # forward scan
        p_max, p_end = _telo_scan(seq_up, rotations, mlen, penalty, dropoff, skip_first=True, profile=do_profile, out=out, name=rec.name, tag='P')
        # reverse scan on reverse complement
        rc = revcomp(seq_up)
        q_max, q_end = _telo_scan(rc, rotations, mlen, penalty, dropoff, skip_first=False, profile=do_profile, out=out, name=rec.name, tag='Q')
        if not do_profile:
            if p_max >= min_score:
                out.write(rec.name + ("\t%d\t%d\t%d\n" % (0, p_end, L)).encode())
                telo_bases += p_end
            if q_max >= min_score:
                q_start = L - q_end
                out.write(rec.name + ("\t%d\t%d\t%d\n" % (q_start, L, L)).encode())
                telo_bases += q_end
        else:
            if p_max >= min_score:
                telo_bases += p_end
            if q_max >= min_score:
                telo_bases += q_end
    err_bytes("%d\t%d\n" % (telo_bases, total_bases))
    return 0

USAGE_MAIN = """
Usage:   seqtk <command> <arguments>
Version: 1.5-r133

Command: seq       common transformation of FASTA/Q
         size      report the number sequences and bases
         comp      get the nucleotide composition of FASTA/Q
         sample    subsample sequences
         subseq    extract subsequences from FASTA/Q
         fqchk     fastq QC (base/quality summary)
         mergepe   interleave two PE FASTA/Q files
         split     split one file into multiple smaller files
         trimfq    trim FASTQ using the Phred algorithm

         hety      regional heterozygosity
         gc        identify high- or low-GC regions
         mutfa     point mutate FASTA at specified positions
         mergefa   merge two FASTA/Q files
         famask    apply a X-coded FASTA to a source FASTA
         dropse    drop unpaired from interleaved PE FASTA/Q
         rename    rename sequence names
         randbase  choose a random base from hets
         cutN      cut sequence at long N
         gap       get the gap locations
         listhet   extract the position of each het
         hpc       homopolyer-compressed sequence
         telo      identify telomere repeats in asm or long reads

"""

def main(argv):
    if len(argv) < 2:
        err_bytes(USAGE_MAIN)
        return 1
    cmd = argv[1]
    args = argv[2:]
    table = {

new='''def _trim_bounds(qual, thresh, min_len):
    L = len(qual)
    if min_len < 0 or L <= min_len:
        return (0, L)
    # prefix sums of (thresh - error_prob), error prob with q floored at 3
    pref = [0.0]*(L+1)
    for i in range(L):
        q = qual[i] - 33
        if q < 3: q = 3
        pref[i+1] = pref[i] + (thresh - 10 ** (-q / 10.0))
    best_score = None; best_beg = 0; best_end = min_len
    min_pref = float('inf'); min_beg = 0
    for end in range(min_len, L+1):
        nb = end - min_len
        if pref[nb] < min_pref:
            min_pref = pref[nb]; min_beg = nb
        score = pref[end] - min_pref
        if best_score is None or score > best_score:
            best_score = score; best_beg = min_beg; best_end = end
    return (best_beg, best_end)

'''

import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/seqtk.py');s=p.read_text()
start=s.index("def _telo_scan(")
end=s.index("def cmd_telo(args):")
new='''def _telo_scan(seq_norm, rotations, mlen, penalty, dropoff, skip_first, profile, out, name, tag):
    L = len(seq_norm)
    score = 0; max_score = 0; max_end = 0
    if mlen <= 0 or L < mlen:
        return (0, 0)
    # Loop over display positions.  P: pos is 0-based index; Q: q = t+1 over revcomp.
    # At each step we first (optionally) print the current score, then process
    # the base at that position, which may score a k-mer ending at it.
    for t in range(L):
        if profile:
            if tag == 'P':
                out.write(("P\\t%s\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n" % (name.decode('latin1'), t, score, max_score)).encode())
            else:
                out.write(("Q\\t%s\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n" % (name.decode('latin1'), t + 1, score, max_score)).encode())
        # process base t: score k-mer ending at t
        if tag == 'P':
            do_score = t >= mlen          # first scored start is 1
            start = t - mlen + 1
        else:
            do_score = t >= mlen - 1      # first scored start is 0
            start = t - mlen + 1
        if do_score and 0 <= start <= L - mlen:
            kmer = seq_norm[start:start+mlen]
            score += 1 if kmer in rotations else -penalty
            if score > max_score:
                max_score = score; max_end = start + mlen
        if max_score - score > dropoff:
            break
    return (max_score, max_end)

'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
p.write_text(s)

  isdrop = (maxs-score>X) if drop_cond=='>' else (maxs-score>=X)
